Chapter 540: Chapter 2: The Junior Apprentice Brother is Ninth Rank, and We Are Still Sixth Rank? (Please Subscribe)

Ninth Rank battles, akin to competition in a spatial sense.

In this regard, Ninth Rank Evolvers who have opened up more spatial layers possess a greater advantage.

It’s not just about the heritage and power that multiple spatial layers bring.

They can also merge and occupy more spatial layers.

Just like right now.

Lin Yuan seemed to be standing in front of Hongpi with blue eyes.

...

But his true body was in some unknown spatial layer.

Ninth Rank powerhouses… strictly speaking, belonged to multi-spatial life.

They were not confined to a single spatial layer like most other life forms.

Next,

Lin Yuan gave a few more instructions.

He ordered his subordinates to immediately appease the other Evolvers on the Milky Way Main Star.

The commotion he caused when he broke through to Ninth Rank, even without relying on observational equipment, could give rise to an indescribable sense of palpitation in some Evolvers on the main star.

It was like how some animals on a planet, facing disasters in other regions, would feel terror and tremble even if it did not affect them directly.

…

Star Lord’s Great Hall.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

In front of him, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit also sat, face calm.

“Now we can try the ‘Illusory Reality’ inheritance secret technique.”

Lin Yuan thought slightly.

“‘Illusory Reality’ converts the essence of life, turning the illusory into reality, and the reality into illusory.”

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit, being a soul body, essentially belonged to the illusory. By using “Illusory Reality,” it could obtain a flesh and blood body and thereby share many Divine Skills and treasures bestowed upon Lin Yuan.

“Begin.”

Lin Yuan looked at the Taiyin Primordial Spirit in front of him.

At this moment, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit had already started to activate “Illusory Reality”. The originally illusory body began to boil, with its most microscopic particles slowly transforming.

“Everything is going smoothly.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Using a Primordial Spirit Body to activate “Illusory Reality”, even if it failed, it was just a Primordial Spirit that could be reconstituted in the blink of an eye.

“It will probably take about half a month to completely convert.”

Lin Yuan observed carefully and concluded.

The conversion of life essence required a significant amount of time to adapt; it couldn’t be accomplished overnight, especially converting from illusory to real.

“Let’s convert the Taiyin Primordial Spirit first to see the effect. If possible, then convert the Taiyang Divine Spirit.”

Lin Yuan secretly thought to himself. So far, he did not know if the converted Taiyin Primordial Spirit could function like his own True Body Venerable; he was just guessing that it most likely wouldn’t have any problems.

“Come in.”

Lin Yuan absorbed the Taiyin Primordial Spirit into his Inner World, and his consciousness also descended.

“Now the Inner World looks much more pleasing.” Lin Yuan surveyed the vast universe in front of him once more; after creating numerous spatial layers through expansion, the Inner World had become significantly more substantial.

Now it truly resembled a real world.

However, currently, the Inner World, lacking the support of the Rule of Time, could only rely on the time rules of the Main Universe; it was not a complete world.

“Oh!”

Lin Yuan briefly scanned the Inner World, his gaze suddenly pausing on the World Tree.

Lin Yuan, now a Ninth Rank life form, could see through multiple spatial layers at a glance, especially since this was a world he had opened up himself; he was as familiar with the more than thirty thousand spatial layers as the back of his hand.

And at this moment, the World Tree, though its main body was in the primary space, its roots penetrated many spatial layers, continuously absorbing the power from different layers.

“I didn’t expect the World Tree to have this ability?”

Lin Yuan was somewhat surprised. Exploring and occupying other spatial layers was an ability controlled by Ninth-Rank life forms, although some Eighth Rank life forms could also achieve this, but very crudely.

The ability displayed by the World Tree was far beyond what an Eighth-Rank Evolver could compare with.

“Truly deserving as an Eleven-Star Cosmic Rare Treasure.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

If it weren’t for using his identity as a member of the Magic Jade Tower, Lin Yuan would never have been able to access the World Tree. Even if he had advanced to the Ninth or Tenth Rank, there was virtually no chance.

In the Main Universe, the World Tree was extremely rare.

Magic Jade Tower was a force from outside the world and was extremely flourishing in a distant past, so there was a young World Tree sapling on the reward list of the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

…

Time passed.

In just over ten days.

Lin Yuan’s advancement to Ninth Rank, after confirmation by three goddesses and with Lin Yuan’s own consent, was officially announced in the name of Human Civilization.

The announcement was instantly spread across the five star domains of human civilization and the numerous different species and several peak clans around received the news immediately.

Not yet a hundred years old.

To be precise, under sixty years old, he stepped into Ninth Rank.

And he did so with the identity of the historically strongest Eighth Rank.

Many halos.

Many honors.

All converged upon Lin Yuan.

…

Insect Race Territory.

A massive Insect Race Hive, the terrifying aura began sweeping in all directions.

“Who is it?”

“Who is responsible for the assassination of the Galactic Star Lord?”

“The Galactic Star Lord was not even Sixth Rank before, so easy to assassinate, yet allowed to grow to today? To grow to Ninth Rank? And likely to advance to Tenth Rank or even Tier 11?”

This Insect Race Hive emitted an extremely furious psychic wave.

If they had not paid attention to the Galactic Star Lord before, that would be one thing.

But the Galactic Star Lord had already caught the eyes of the Insect Race and other species in the alliance and even launched assassination operations using the most inexplicable Curse-Killing Skill.

So they just gave up because they chose the wrong target?

Choosing the wrong target can’t they continue to choose?

At worst, curse-kill every test-taker with a gold pattern or above in that session of the Seven Star Cave.

How much would that cost?

“Venerate…”
